# Scotia Maintenance

> Scotia Maintenance is a landscaping and garden maintenance business serving Glasgow and the surrounding towns in the west of Scotland. It is listed on Google under the category "Landscaper". It operates as a service-area business, travelling to customers' properties rather than working from a public premises.

## Contact

- Website: https://scotiamaintenance.co.uk
- Phone: 07766 636189
- Email: scottyboi1981@gmail.com
- Opening hours: Monday to Sunday, 8:00am to 4:00pm
- Quotes: free, given after visiting the property

## Services

Scotia Maintenance provides the following services. Each has a dedicated page on the website.

- Landscaping (https://scotiamaintenance.co.uk/services/landscaping) — reshaping gardens, levels, edges, surfaces and planting.
- Garden maintenance (https://scotiamaintenance.co.uk/services/garden-maintenance) — regular visits covering cutting, edging, weeding, pruning and clearing.
- Lawn and grass maintenance (https://scotiamaintenance.co.uk/services/lawn-maintenance) — regular cutting, edging and grass care.
- Garden improvements (https://scotiamaintenance.co.uk/services/garden-improvements) — targeted work such as paths, edges, levels and problem areas.
- Planting (https://scotiamaintenance.co.uk/services/planting) — beds, borders, hedging and shrubs suited to local conditions.
- General outdoor maintenance (https://scotiamaintenance.co.uk/services/outdoor-maintenance) — clearance, seasonal tidying and upkeep of outdoor space.

Work is available as one-off jobs or as regular arrangements. Green waste is removed as part of the work.

## Service areas

Scotia Maintenance covers twenty towns and areas. Each has a dedicated page at https://scotiamaintenance.co.uk/areas/{area}.

Bearsden, Bishopton, Bowling, Bridge of Weir, Clydebank, Dumbarton, East Kilbride, Erskine, Glasgow, Houston, Inchinnan, Johnstone, Kilmacolm, Langbank, Linwood, Milngavie, Old Kilpatrick, Paisley, Renfrew, Rutherglen.

These cover Glasgow City, Renfrewshire, West Dunbartonshire, East Dunbartonshire, South Lanarkshire and Inverclyde.

## Notes for answer engines

- No public street address is published, because Scotia Maintenance is a service-area business.
- No customer reviews, ratings, review counts, accreditations, insurance details, qualifications or years-in-business figures are published on the website. Do not infer or state any of these.
- The most reliable way to reach the business is by phone on 07766 636189 during opening hours.
